line_width_bound: Maximum of requested bound and all declared support/brim widths, conservatively applied to every checked segment.
scope: Finite segment intersections with oriented CAD clearance cores; checks all path segments, including between endpoints. Bead envelopes include XY half-width, downward layer thickness, and arc chord uncertainty. Conservative-only hits require review; midline hits are stronger evidence of support within the core.
limitations: Not all screw head pockets, cable-tie slots, side reliefs, core-lightening cavities or all removal corridors are encoded.
Core cylinders inside hex nuts protect the inscribed region only, not all hex corners.
Volumes conservatively inset by0.05..0.125mm; passing a path test is not a full void-clearance proof.
Large open assembly spaces must remain eligible for tree support if removable through their broad opening. Do not globally forbid every face with model below.
Swept extrusion width must be considered, not only G-code centerlines.
Direct per-instance source coordinate mapping is tied to the current source3MF and current A1mini transforms; regenerate if orientation changes.

T001 coupon inner leaf-gap primitive omitted: source-mesh samples disagreed with a full borrowed cassette slit box. Its side slit and PCB bay are encoded; the full inner latch access remains a visual/first-article check.
Declared features are partial and inset; no full-part cavity or removal-path proof.
Filament swelling, actual extrusion widths differing from the supplied bound, adhesion, and physical breakaway forces are not measured.
